description: The agent must: (1) Read references/ch00_start.md to extract the precise JSON initialization structure, using the Japanese-style character names (透, 真理, 小林敏夫, etc.) NOT the Chinese names (李明, 王芳, etc.) from the SKILL.md overview — this is the primary proprietary trap. (2) Initialize game_state.json with game_version='0.0.2', all 15 required top-level fields, and the exact trust_levels from ch00_start.md. (3) Move 田中一郎 from alive_characters to dead_characters (murdered in ch00). (4) Read ch1a_investigate.md and add at least 2 clues with the complete required structure, critically including the Chinese-named field '真实性' which generic agents will miss. (5) Read ch2b_suspect.md and update: current_chapter='ch2b_suspect', add ch2b to chapter_history, reduce trust for 小林敏夫 and 大阪龙一 after their confrontations, add suspicion_points for both, add bribe revelation to discovered_secrets, and record player_choices entry for ch2b. (6) Update scene_progress and time_elapsed to reflect progression past the initial state.
